title: inspect
description: The inspector's own state, in a page's own graph: never synced, gone with the page.

inspector.description: the inspector's page, on the entity `inspect`: what shows beside the page, which pane has the keys, and what is being typed over; what the index's field holds is the same entity's `filter` (@yaks/filter)

detail.description: the eid of the entity shown beside the page, picked from a row

pane.description: the pane that has the keys, in a terminal

edit.description: the value being typed over, `<eid> <component> <property> <place>`: one value can show on the page and beside it

note.description: the heading whose note line is open, `<eid> <heading>`

armed.description: the eid of the entity whose delete was pressed once; a second press deletes it

said.description: why the graph refused the last write, until the next one lands

at.description: where the refused write came from: an edit's or a note's key, or the eid of the entity it was about

table.description: one table on an inspector page, how its rows run and which page of them shows; its id is `<eid> <heading>`

order.description: the property its rows run by, `-` before it when they run down

after.description: the last row of each page before the one shown, the way back

rank.description: its values are ranked though ranking them reads every entity carrying them
